account_population.binary_safety: NUL в /etc/passwd, /etc/login.defs или local sensitive-file inventory даёт ERROR до Bash line parsing.
account_population.home_state: Absent candidate home is skipped; existing home must be a readable/searchable real directory. Symlink or non-directory home is ERROR. Physical home identities are deduplicated.
account_population.nss_scope: Only local /etc/passwd rows are authoritative in v1; network/NSS-only accounts are outside this adapter population and require a future explicitly modelled authority if brought into product scope.
account_population.rationale: Current product operationalizes source term «пользователей» as root plus normal local interactive accounts. This avoids treating service-account state directories as human home directories while retaining root; the same selector was exercised on all seven read-only VM evidence runs.
account_population.selector: uid==0 OR (uid>=UID_MIN AND uid!=65534), shell basename not in {nologin,false}, absolute home path
account_population.uid_min_failure: Missing, duplicate, malformed or unreadable UID_MIN authority is ERROR.

donor_disposition.adapt: Donor /home direct-directory scan is replaced by an explicit passwd/login.defs account selector that includes root and is not tied to /home.
donor_disposition.reject: Hard-coding only the donor eight names as source-complete is rejected because SRC-0014 says «и т. п.» twice.
donor_disposition.reuse: Donor exact chmod go-rwx relation (mode & 0077 == 0) and the eight explicit source-example names.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs exercised the selected account heuristic and direct source-example discovery. Evidence supports implementation assumptions; it does not turn observed host modes into normative policy and does not extend SUPPORTED target beyond ubuntu-24.04-x86_64.

non_requirements.file_contents: No sensitive file contents are read or emitted.
non_requirements.home_mode: Home directory mode 0700 belongs to SRC-0015 and is not added to SRC-0014.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is evidence only and is not added to SRC-0014.

permissions_control.comparison: For each present regular inventory member, mode & 0077 == 0; this is the exact chmod go-rwx relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more present sensitive files have any group/other rwx bit.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated and violations=0.

sensitive_file_population.format: Line-oriented relative hidden paths under each selected home; blank and # lines ignored; duplicates, absolute paths, control characters or unsafe syntax are ERROR. Nested relative paths are allowed.
sensitive_file_population.missing_authority: Missing, symlink, unreadable or malformed inventory is ERROR, not PASS.
sensitive_file_population.missing_member: A listed path absent from a selected home is not a violation; present members are checked.
sensitive_file_population.open_ended_source: The two source phrases «и т. п.» are not silently reduced to the eight examples. A local inventory is mandatory and asserts the complete locally applicable set of shell history/config/R-subsystem sensitive paths.
sensitive_file_population.source_scope_note: The inventory path is a deterministic current-product authority for the source’s open-ended «и т. п.» wording, not a separate FSTEC-mandated file path.
sensitive_file_population.symlink_policy: Any symlink in an inventory path is ERROR rather than following a target outside the asserted home population.
